Title: Budget Control + Failure Fingerprints
Summary: CONTROL/DECISION FOUNDATION. Consumes cost evidence (DB-M17 attempt records, DB-M16 FX) and produces a structured BudgetEvaluation v1 -- never calculates model prices, never executes a provider/model. No paid API call, no network call, AUTO_EXECUTION_ENABLED = FALSE. Budget scopes TASK/CHANGE/SESSION/DAILY/MONTHLY/TEAM (generic scope keys, no Nexus coupling); nullable limits (null = scope not configured, never an infinite sentinel); actual-preferred spend with estimated-pending separated; warning thresholds with strictest-wins precedence; unknown-cost policy (never treat unknown as zero); explicit-only human override (Only explicit provided override evidence counts); human Git / governance gates consume ZERO AI budget; deterministic day/month windows from the INJECTED evaluation timestamp + AccountingUtcOffsetHours (never machine clock); DB-M16 currency conversion semantics (explicit ExchangeRate wins, else Get-AiExchangeRateAt; conversion unavailable -> controlled CURRENCY_UNAVAILABLE uncertainty, never an invented rate). FailureFingerprint v1: canonical identity = SHA-256 over fp<version>|<TaskType>|<FailureCategory>|<sorted codes>|<ToolCategory>; route/reasoning/context hashes retained as structured fields for recurrence typing (REPEATED_SAME_ROUTE / SAME_MODEL / AFTER_REASONING_ESCALATION / AFTER_MODEL_SWITCH / SAME_FAILURE / KNOWN_FAILURE_RESOLVED / FIRST_OCCURRENCE); normalized codes (timestamps/GUIDs/temp paths/user-dir/line-col/retry counters -> stable markers); secret protection (hashes/references only, raw prompts never inputs, secret-like stored value rejects the fingerprint); algorithm versioning (a v2 algorithm must not silently reinterpret v1 fingerprints); provider-vs-model failure separation (AUTHENTICATION/RATE_LIMIT/PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE never poison model quality history); retry suppression (RETRY_SUPPRESSED_KNOWN_FAILURE only for identical route + known-same context above MaxRepeatsBeforeSuppress; context change / reasoning escalation / model switch -> RETRY_ALLOWED_*); repeated failures are evidence-only signals, never roadmap changes (PERSISTENT_IMPLEMENTATION_FAILURE evidence-only, NEW_FIX_TASK_REQUIRED represent-only). Combined Get-AiAttemptPermission: ALLOW_ATTEMPT / ALLOW_WITH_BUDGET_WARNING / BLOCK_BUDGET / BLOCK_KNOWN_FAILURE_REPEAT / REQUIRE_HUMAN_OVERRIDE / REQUIRE_ESCALATION_REPLAN. DB-M20 consumed read-only (failure categories, actions, statuses, AutoExecutionEnabled; Status != RECOMMENDED -> REQUIRE_ESCALATION_REPLAN, never a retry). Budget block -> DB-M20 STOP_BUDGET_LIMIT semantics; DB-M20 cannot bypass the block. Git human gates (HUMAN_GIT_ACTION_REQUIRED, AWAITING_HUMAN_PR, PR_OPEN, AWAITING_HUMAN_MERGE) are NOT AI failures and consume no retry/escalation budget; budget logic never bypasses them.
